items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: And he was playing, he could play flute and clarinet and he was a drummer. And he played Chicken Reel better than I did on the flute.

ctx.x: Is that a flute like this or like this?

No, the nickel flutes. One of these nickel, you used to call it a nickel flute. Nickel flute, yeah. We played six songs as High Society and Chicken Reel. Oh, the marches on it. And what made me put on the flute was a fellow by the name of Joe Ranney, Ranney's brother. Well, they was in the home before I went out there. And he was playing, he could play flute and clarinet and he was a drummer. And he played Chicken Reel better than I did on the flute. And I said, well, I ain't playing no more flute. So I'd taken…
Well back to your parents, did your father and your relatives over there in the back each of the, did they all play fingerstyle?
